data.title: Nepal flood reconstruction bill estimated at $4.8 billion
data.description: KATHMANDU - Nepal estimates the reconstruction bill after deadly floods sparked by a glacial mountain collapse last month will amount to $4.78 billion, the foreign ministry said on Friday.

data.title: Doomsday tech: could AI really kill us all?
data.description: TOKYO - Stark warnings from artificial intelligence researchers that advanced forms of the technology could wipe out humanity have raised questions over whether governments are moving fast enough to regulate it.

data.title: Houthis ‘complete takeover’ of Bab al-Mandab area
data.description: SANAA, Yemen - Houthi rebels on Friday seized a key Red Sea island in the middle of the Bab al-Mandab strait, completing a push to take control of a waterway crucial to Saudi oil exports, a local government official and eyewitnesses told AFP.

data.title: Korat’s almost B90M in abandoned public facilities raise questions over state spending
data.description: NAKHON RATCHASIMA — Locals of Nakhon Ratchasima have begun questioning the management of state-funded projects after a public library and observatory, built at a cost of nearly 90 million baht, had public access rescinded and were left to deterioriate for over a decade.

data.title: Former abbot, woman remanded over alleged financial misconduct
data.description: Police presented the former abbot of Wat Phutthaisawan in Ayutthaya and a woman accused of acting his accomplice to their first remand hearing after investigators alleged that more than 100 million baht in temple donations had been misappropriated.

data.title: Over 30% of unmarried people in Japan do not want children: survey
data.description: KYODO — More than 30% of unmarried people aged between 18 and 34 in Japan do not wish to have children, the highest percentage since comparable data became available in 2002, a government survey showed Friday.

data.title: Pataya Food Group Partners with Japan’s Umios to Drive Asian Growth
data.description: BANGKOK — Pataya Food Group (PFG) , owner of Nautilus, Mongkut Talay, Sea Crown, Regalos, and Remy, announces a strategic partnership with Umios Corporation (Japan) to accelerate growth across Asia. The alliance combines PFG’s strengths in brand building and channel management with Umios Group’s global network and industry expertise. Together, the companies aim to support PFG's ambition of achieving average annual growth of 10% , guided by the shared mission of “Enrich People's Life.”

data.title: Italian feminist fighter Emma Bonino dies
data.description: ROME - Italy's Emma Bonino, a long-time radical activist and one of the country's most popular political figures, has died aged 78.

data.title: Thai FDA reports no national medicine shortage amid local supply gaps
data.description: A fact-finding report is expected within three days after a medicine shortage was confirmed at the Chiang Mai hospital, while the FDA reports no nationwide medicine shortage.

data.title: Armed robber takes B1.5m  from Pathum Thani bank, burns getaway car
data.description: PATHUM THANI - An armed robber who made off with 1.5 million baht after robbing a bank in Khlong Luang district on Thursday afternoon later set fire to the car he used in the heist in an apparent attempt to destroy evidence.

data.title: Indonesia to bring back baby orangutans allegedly trafficked to India
data.description: JAKARTA - Indonesian authorities have begun working to repatriate five baby orangutans allegedly trafficked to India, where they were found motherless in a forest, Jakarta's forestry ministry told AFP Friday.

data.title: Fast-pace dance takes I.Coast's working-class streets by storm
data.description: ABIDJAN - On the streets of a working-class Abidjan neighbourhood, hundreds of young people gather every week after class to dance the biama, a high-tempo combo of acrobatic twists, frenetic footwork and funny facial expressions.

data.title: Thai-Malaysian families could be impacted by shortened visa-free stay
data.description: Malaysians married to Thai nationals could be the group affected by the 30-day visa-free programme which will take effect next week.

data.title: 'Desperate' Sabalenka books US Open title clash with Rybakina
data.description: NEW YORK — Aryna Sabalenka stormed past Jessica Pegula in straight sets on Thursday to keep her bid for a rare US Open three-peat on track, booking a championship showdown with Elena Rybakina.
